visual_personality: Authoritative restraint. The studio itself is a portfolio piece — the design demonstrates what the studio believes. Light background, near-black ink, generous white space. Work carries the visual weight; UI steps back.
color_philosophy: Near-black #111110 against warm white #F8F7F4. Off-white #F0EFEB for alternate section backgrounds. Single accent — muted slate blue #3D5A73 — used sparingly for interactive states, hover hints, and numeric callouts. No gradients on light sections. Dark sections use #111110 as a full-bleed reversal.
typography_system: Cormorant Garamond (font-heading) for all display text, headlines, and quotes. Light and regular weights dominate — 300 and 400. Heavy weight reserved for nothing. Inter (font-body) for all UI, labels, body text, navigation. Radical size contrast: hero at clamp(3.5rem,7vw,5.5rem), section h2 at clamp(2.5rem,5vw,3.75rem). This size difference communicates hierarchy before a word is read.
spacing_philosophy: Very generous. Section vertical padding starts at py-24 and often reaches py-32. Internal gaps at gap-12 minimum. The site breathes. Cramped sections would be an aesthetic contradiction for a minimalist studio.
layout_patterns: Homepage hero: asymmetric 12-column grid, 5 left (text) + 6 right (image). Project grid: full-width large projects alternate with paired half-width. Services: alternating image/text left-right. No centered layouts for primary content — asymmetry signals a human eye was involved.
component_vocabulary: Cards: no box shadows on light backgrounds — separation is achieved via spacing only. Tags: pill-shaped with border, no fill (hover/active adds fill). Buttons: flat #111110, 2px border-radius (a deliberate near-sharp that reads as precise, not aggressive). CTA hover: shifts to accent blue. Borders: 1px #E2E1DD used sparingly as section separators and form underlines.
navigation_pattern: Split nav desktop: links left and right of centered logo. Sticky with backdrop blur. Full-screen overlay mobile menu with Cormorant Garamond at display scale (clamp 2.5–4rem). 72px header height.
section_rhythm: Light (#F8F7F4) → dark (#111110) → light → light alternate (#F0EFEB). The dark band at services/values provides visual rest and signals importance. Never two dark sections adjacent.
image_direction: Architecture, interior editorial, and professional images. Cool-to-neutral palette. Aspect ratios are intentional: hero project at 4/5 portrait (tall, editorial); portfolio large project at 16/9 (cinema); portfolio grid halves at 1/1 square. Images always have hover scale transform — subtle motion signals interactivity.
anti_patterns: No decorative gradients. No rounded corners beyond 3px. No colorful cards or illustrated icons. No stock-feeling image categories. No bold color outside the dark band. No centered hero text — asymmetry is part of the visual identity.
dark_section_rules: Dark (#111110) sections use divider grid with gap-px bg-white/10 — this creates hairline borders between cards without any border property. Text at white/40 for body, white for headings. Hover shifts bg to #1a1a18 — barely perceptible, the subtlety is intentional.
scroll_reveal_timing: 0.9s cubic-bezier(0.16,1,0.3,1) for primary reveals. 0.7s for stagger children. Stagger delays at 100ms intervals. Slow timing suits the studio's measured aesthetic — snappy animation would feel wrong.
